educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: CENTER OF MASS & SUPPORT
missions.concept: Static support margin depends on where the total center of mass projects relative to the active contact region.
missions.scenario: Shift torso and payload while the robot stands on a finite support area.
missions.goalText: Create positive support margin instead of merely keeping the robot visually upright.
missions.transferText: Recover support margin after the payload moves.

missions.title: CONTACT & FRICTION
missions.concept: Ground contact can only supply forces inside friction and unilateral-contact limits; more commanded force does not create more traction.
missions.scenario: Push laterally without exceeding the stance foot's available friction.
missions.goalText: Generate useful horizontal force while preserving friction margin.
missions.transferText: Adapt force demand to the lower-friction surface.

missions.title: FOOT PLACEMENT
missions.concept: When momentum carries the simplified center of mass beyond current support, recovery requires a new contact near the capture point.
missions.scenario: Place the next foot where it can arrest forward motion.
missions.goalText: Place the next contact near the capture point.
missions.transferText: Reposition the next foot for the stronger disturbance.

missions.title: GAIT & WHOLE-BODY CONTROL
missions.concept: Walking is a coordinated contact schedule: clearance, timing, momentum and whole-body tasks compete for limited authority.
missions.scenario: Tune a step that clears the floor without creating excessive impact or losing timing margin.
missions.goalText: Find a gait point with floor clearance, controlled impact and usable swing timing.
missions.transferText: Adapt the gait to a higher obstacle without simply maximizing clearance.

missions.title: RECOVERY & FALL MANAGEMENT
missions.concept: Recovery authority is finite; beyond the available contact and step envelope, the correct action may become controlled fall rather than impossible stabilization.
missions.scenario: Respond to a push using foot placement and upper-body momentum before recovery margin disappears.
missions.goalText: Recover the disturbance with positive capture margin.
missions.transferText: Explore the boundary: if positive recovery cannot be created, minimize the deficit — this is where controlled-fall logic becomes necessary.

missions.title: LOCOMOTION GATE
missions.concept: Demonstrate support, friction, capture-point stepping, gait constraints and recovery reasoning in one locomotion gate.
missions.scenario: Cross a mixed-surface corridor while carrying a load.
missions.goalText: Complete the three locomotion gate cases.

gateCases.name: NOMINAL WALK
gateCases.text: Step reach must exceed capture need by 4 cm.

gateCases.name: LOW FRICTION
gateCases.text: Keep speed low enough that demand proxy stays below 75% of friction capacity.

gateCases.name: RECOVERY
gateCases.text: At higher speed, preserve both capture and friction margin.
